name: NativeSelect
purpose: Preserve browser-native option selection with coordinated Field and Form semantics.
useWhen: The browser or operating system should present predefined options.

avoidWhen.condition: Rich option content or editable filtering is needed.

composition: Render NativeSelect.Root with native option and optgroup children, usually inside a labelled Field.

rules.statement: Keep selection, keyboard and uncontrolled reset native; do not add a popup or hidden duplicate value.
Supply an accessible name through Field.Label or native label/ARIA and preserve native name, required and form.
Do not emulate readonly by disabling the select; native select has no readonly state.

commonMistakes.mistake: Confusing the custom Select form proxy with a native picker.
commonMistakes.correction: Use NativeSelect.Root as the visible native control.

validation: Verify native selection, multiple values, grouping, disabled options, form reset and external association.
Verify Field labels/descriptions and state precedence, native validation, SSR, refs, keyboard and physical mobile picker.
